STRUCTURALLY CLEAN: Agent C confirmed MIGRATED arrays are structurally clean. No DL-023/017/018 issues.

SEQUENTIAL LOGIC: Base_A (120/120) and Base_B (75/75) are already 100% Certified. Base_C and Base_D are the logical next MIGRATED targets. Completing the MIGRATED series gives 4 fully certified arrays (390 items) before tackling the more complex ENHANCED arrays.

The S511 CASE-B12-Q4 discovery proved this step catches formula errors BEFORE they're certified.
Read-only — zero risk of file corruption, no backup protocol needed.
